aiDescription.summary: This Senate resolution directs the Secretary of State to submit a 30‑day section 502B(c) report, prepared with the State Department’s DRL and Legal Adviser, on Kosovo’s human rights practices. It focuses on alleged abuses against non‑Kosovo citizens the U.S. sent to Kosovo, U.S. assessments of detention conditions and security‑assistance risks, agreements/transfers in 2025–26, and U.S. efforts to prevent or remedy renditions, trafficking, detention, or returns.

description.text: A resolution requesting information on the Republic of Kosovo's human rights practices pursuant to section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

impact.summary: The resolution directs the Secretary of State and the Assistant Secretary for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor to submit under 22 U.S.C. 2304(c) a report to the Senate Foreign Relations and House Foreign Affairs Committees within 30 days. It demands information on Kosovo’s human‑rights record, treatment of non‑Kosovans the U.S. removed (including 2025–2026), U.S. security assistance, agreements, and related meetings.
